Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2128 West Eastwood Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 3,615 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to redevelop the subject property with a new
two-story residential building containing two (2) dwelling units. The
proposed building will measure 35 ft. in height. The subject property is a
Transit Served Location and will not provide off-street parking. The new
building will be supported by four (4) bicycle parking spaces at the rear.
Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and
Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking ratio for
a Transit Served Location from 50% (1 parking space) to zero and is seeking
all zoning relief, as necessary and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code,
for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 3,313 square feet (0.92 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 1,807.5 square feet per D.U.
(2 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: zero parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Damen CTA Brown
line station), Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce
the required number of off-street parking spaces from one (1) parking spaces (50%)
to zero parking spaces.

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 11.58 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 4.49 feet
West Side: 3 feet
c. Rear Setback: 34,97 feet

(E) ‘Building Height: 35 feet
